item.title: New tier list for Street Fighter 6 released by Pochoclo23 before the Alex update changes everything

item.title: 2XKO input lag tests revealed with some interesting results
item.description: <p>Fighting game players have always cared about latency on the systems they play on, and now it's easier than ever to get the precise data on the amount of lag present (at least for those with the technical know how).</p> <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/19/season-1-patch-notes-2xko/">2XKO recently launched in full this month</a> finally including the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S in on the action, so how does the League of Legends fighter stack up in terms of lag?</p>

item.title: Evo 2026 early entrant registration rankings revealed for all 12 games
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/09/evo-2026-game-lineup/">Evo 2026</a> is planning to run more games on the mainstage with 12 titles over the usual 8 from recent years, and they'll be pulling in communities from all across the genre.</p> <p>With early bird registration coming to a close, the organizers have now revealed the current entrant leaderboard for Evo 2026.</p>

item.title: The Nintendo Switch 2 outpaces its predecessor's record-breaking sales as Super Smash Bros. Ultimate continues to push more copies
item.description: <p>After stumbling heavily with the Wii U generation, the house of Mario now seems to be standing to reach larger heights than ever before.</p> <p>Nintendo has now updated its <a href="https://www.nintendo.co.jp/ir/en/finance/hard_soft/index.html">console and video game sales data</a>, which reveals multiple records being broken for the wider Switch family.</p>

item.title: Sega vs. Capcom new trailer reveals more characters, improved visuals, Third Strike announcer and a launch for the fan game
item.description: <p>The fan developers in the fighting game community will never cease to amaze whether it be for character mods or actual game projects.</p> <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2023/nov/01/sega-capcom-fan-project-showcase/">Sega vs. Capcom: The Next Level</a> has now received a new trailer for the start of 2026, and the fan-made crossover fighting game is now looking and sounding better than ever.</p>

item.title: Over 240 days have passed after Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls was first revealed without a single new character since then
